name: astro-plugins
description: Personal Claude Code plugins for solo hobby projects.

plugins.name: inline-thinking
plugins.description: Draws Claude's thinking in the chat, above the reply or tool call it led to, in place of the folded "Thought for 4s".

plugins.name: gates
plugins.description: Gates that refuse risky Bash commands (pkill, kill by pattern, git add -A, git commit -a) and tell Claude why and what to run instead.

plugins.name: global-memory
plugins.description: Memories Claude writes for every project, kept in ~/.claude/memory and loaded into each session, and /global-memory:suggest, which turns them and your session history into rules for your global ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md. Writes only the rules you approve.

plugins.name: github-tracking
plugins.description: Keeps a repo's GitHub issues, milestones and Projects board true while Claude works: each change starts from an issue on the board, larger steps split into sub-issues, and status updates say where the project stands.

plugins.name: screen-polish
plugins.description: Redraws the transcript in a refined style: one aligned row per tool call with a status glyph and a short result, an accent prompt marker, indented replies, a spinner that says what the turn is doing and a thin rule closing each turn.
